label: ITEMINFO_1579
text: Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this\nhoney to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also\nhas the same effect as a Max Revive.

label: ITEMINFO_1580
text: Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax\nforms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.

label: ITEMINFO_1581
text: A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows\nin certain areas around the Galar region. It’s a material\nfor an accessory for a certain Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1582
text: A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs.\nGiving it to a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon\nvery happy.

label: ITEMINFO_1583
text: Having one of these cards increases the selection\navailable to you in boutiques and hair salons.

label: ITEMINFO_1584
text: A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail\nstaff at Wedgehurst Station.

label: ITEMINFO_1585
text: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water\nusing Rotom’s power. It’s a sparkling white that\nshines brilliantly.

label: ITEMINFO_1586
text: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water\nusing Rotom’s power. It’s a glistening black that\nshines reddish-black.

label: ITEMINFO_1587
text: Having one of these charms increases the Exp. Points\nyour Pokémon get. It’s a strange, stretchy charm that\nencourages growth.

label: ITEMINFO_1588
text: Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor.\nSomething good will happen if you give it to a collector\non the Isle of Armor.

label: ITEMINFO_1589
text: Having one of these mysterious and unique charms\nmakes it more likely you’ll encounter a Pokémon with\na mark.

label: ITEMINFO_1590
text: Reins that people presented to the king. They enhance\nCalyrex’s power over bountiful harvests and unite\nCalyrex with its beloved steed.

label: ITEMINFO_1591
text: Reins that people presented to the king. They enable\nthose who are connected to communicate with each\nother. The reins separate Calyrex and its beloved steed.

label: ITEMINFO_1592
text: A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs.\nPlacing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes\nthe Pokémon very happy.

label: ITEMINFO_1593
text: A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It’s written\nby Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.

label: ITEMINFO_1594
text: A clue about the legend of giants. It’s written\nby Peony and has unique drawings.

label: ITEMINFO_1595
text: A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It’s written\nby Peony and has a unique drawing.

label: ITEMINFO_1596
text: A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped.\nThere’s a photo attached to it showing a shining hole\nopening above the Max Lair.

label: ITEMINFO_1597
text: A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail\nstaff at Wedgehurst Station.

label: ITEMINFO_1598
text: A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to\nbe chipped. Maybe it’s meant to be part of something.

label: ITEMINFO_1599
text: A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests\ngave you. It radiates faint light.

label: ITEMINFO_1600
text: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful\nHarvests’ beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong\nand very flexible.

label: ITEMINFO_1601
text: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful\nHarvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very\nsmooth to the touch.

label: ITEMINFO_1602
text: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved\nsteed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.

label: ITEMINFO_1603
text: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved\nsteed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

label: ITEMINFO_1604
text: Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair.\nSomething good will happen if you give it to a\ncollector in the Crown Tundra.

label: ITEMINFO_1605
text: Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you’ll get is\ndetermined by which field you plant the seeds in.

label: ITEMINFO_1606
text: A patch that can be used to change the regular Ability\nof a Pokémon to a rarer Ability.

label: ITEMINFO_1607
text: Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light.\nThe people of old times presented these to the King of\nBountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.

label: ITEMINFO_1608
text: A mysterious balm that somehow has the power to calm\nDialga in its frenzy.

label: ITEMINFO_1609
text: A mysterious balm that somehow has the power to calm\nPalkia in its frenzy.

label: ITEMINFO_1610
text: A mysterious balm to be used when battling Arceus.

label: ITEMINFO_1611
text: A string exuding a mysterious energy that makes you\nfeel a strange sense of connection. It’s loved by\ncertain Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1612
text: A baked treat made from Berries and other ingredients,\nwhich is often eaten in regions such as Galar. It is\nbeloved by a surprising number of Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1613
text: A fruit whose shell can be used to form the capsules of\nall manner of Poké Balls when crafting them from\nscratch. Its proper name is actually “Brown Apricorn.”

label: ITEMINFO_1614
text: A hidden gem gaining popularity in Jubilife Village and\nbeloved by Pokémon. This sweet treat can be fed to\na Pokémon to cure any status condition it may have.

label: ITEMINFO_1615
text: An item that sharply boosts the offensive and defensive\nstats of a Pokémon in battle. These effects disappear\nif the Pokémon leaves the battle.

label: ITEMINFO_1616
text: An item that sharply boosts the critical-hit ratio of\na Pokémon in battle. This effect disappears if the\nPokémon leaves the battle.

label: ITEMINFO_1617
text: A dumpling that will make a Pokémon become fixated on\na move in battle. The Pokémon will deal more damage\nwhen using that move but will take more damage as well.

label: ITEMINFO_1618
text: These pickled vegetables prime a Pokémon for battle.\nThe Pokémon takes a hard-hitting stance, which boosts\nthe damage dealt by its moves by 50 percent.

label: ITEMINFO_1619
text: When eaten, this curious snack temporarily swaps a\nPokémon’s offensive stats with its defensive stats.

label: ITEMINFO_1620
text: A fern used for crafting items made to be thrown.\nWhen these curled leaves are unfurled, they can serve\nas nature’s wrapping paper.

label: ITEMINFO_1621
text: A rare seed that can be given to the captain of the\nSecurity Corps to have a Pokémon master a move\nso it can be used in the agile style or strong style.

label: ITEMINFO_1624
text: A type of ice beloved by the Lord of the Tundra,\nAvalugg. This ice is said to be fragments of ancient\nAvalugg that lived long ago.

label: ITEMINFO_1625
text: Proof that you have completed the trial set by Uxie,\nthe Being of Knowledge that lives in Lake Acuity.\nThis item is needed to forge the Red Chain.

label: ITEMINFO_1626
text: Proof that you have completed the trial set by Azelf,\nthe Being of Willpower that lives in Lake Valor.\nThis item is needed to forge the Red Chain.

label: ITEMINFO_1627
text: Proof that you have completed the trial set by Mesprit,\nthe Being of Emotion that lives in Lake Verity.\nThis item is needed to forge the Red Chain.

label: ITEMINFO_1628
text: When combined with an Apricorn, this mysterious\ntumbled stone can draw out the properties required\nto forge a Poké Ball.

label: ITEMINFO_1629
text: A flute that can be used to call special Pokémon that\nare willing to bear you around the region. Its timbre is\neerie and mysterious.

label: ITEMINFO_1630
text: An herbal medicine that can restore 60 HP to a\nPokémon, just as a Potion does. Yet the bitter taste\nwill make the Pokémon less friendly toward you.

label: ITEMINFO_1631
text: An herbal medicine that can restore 100 HP to a\nPokémon, just as a Super Potion does. Yet the bitter taste\nwill make the Pokémon less friendly toward you.

label: ITEMINFO_1632
text: Honey that sparkles with an amber hue. It is beloved\nby bug Pokémon and Pokémon with fairylike charms,\nso they will gather wherever a comb of it is thrown.

label: ITEMINFO_1633
text: Beautiful stalks of rice bursting with life. Pokémon that\ndwell and wander among the fields love these grains and\nwill gather wherever the stalks are thrown.

label: ITEMINFO_1634
text: Large, juicy beans that grow in pods. These beans are\nbeloved by fish Pokémon, as well as bird Pokémon and\ntheir flying ilk, so throw one and they will gather around.

label: ITEMINFO_1635
text: A large and well-ripened mushroom. It is beloved by the\nmore monstrous Pokémon, as well as dragon Pokémon,\nso they will gather wherever one is thrown.

label: ITEMINFO_1636
text: Translucent crystals that are beloved by Pokémon\nbearing a resemblance to grass, plants, or minerals.\nThey will gather wherever a lump of this salt is thrown.

label: ITEMINFO_1637
text: A handy log of wood that can be used for anything,\nfrom crafting common goods needed for daily living\nto producing works of art.

label: ITEMINFO_1638
text: The king of herbs, glittering and brilliant. Combining\nthis herb with other materials needed to make medicines\nwill boost their efficacy.

label: ITEMINFO_1639
text: A mysterious balm that gives off a soothing scent.\nIt can be used to help calm the frenzy of the Lady of\nthe Ridge, Lilligant.

label: ITEMINFO_1640
text: A recipe for crafting Poké Balls from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Apricorn and 1 Tumblestone.

label: ITEMINFO_1641
text: A recipe for crafting Great Balls from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Apricorn, 1 Iron Chunk, and\n1 Tumblestone.

label: ITEMINFO_1642
text: A recipe for crafting Ultra Balls from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Apricorn, 2 Iron Chunks, and\n2 Tumblestones.

label: ITEMINFO_1643
text: A recipe for crafting Feather Balls from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Apricorn and 1 Sky Tumblestone.

label: ITEMINFO_1644
text: A recipe for crafting Pokéshi Dolls from scratch.\nRequired materials: 3 logs of Wood.

label: ITEMINFO_1646
text: A recipe for crafting Smoke Bombs from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Caster Fern leaf and\n1 Sootfoot Root.

label: ITEMINFO_1647
text: A recipe for crafting Scatter Bangs from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Pop Pod and 1 Caster Fern leaf.

label: ITEMINFO_1648
text: A recipe for crafting Sticky Globs from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Spoiled Apricorn, 1 Ball of Mud,\nand 1 Caster Fern leaf.

label: ITEMINFO_1649
text: A recipe for crafting Star Pieces from scratch.\nRequired materials: 3 Red Shards, 3 Blue Shards,\n3 Green Shards, and 1 bag of Stardust.

label: ITEMINFO_1650
text: A recipe for crafting Mushroom Cakes from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Springy Mushroom and\n1 Cake-Lure Base.

label: ITEMINFO_1651
text: A wildflower that can be found growing across the Hisui\nregion. It does have medicinal properties, but it is\nso bitter that no wild Pokémon will eat it.

label: ITEMINFO_1652
text: A recipe for crafting Honey Cakes from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 comb of Dazzling Honey and\n1 Cake-Lure Base.

label: ITEMINFO_1653
text: A recipe for crafting Grain Cakes from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 stalk of Hearty Grains and\n1 Cake-Lure Base.

label: ITEMINFO_1654
text: A recipe for crafting Bean Cakes from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 pod of Plump Beans and\n1 Cake-Lure Base.

label: ITEMINFO_1655
text: A recipe for crafting Salt Cakes from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 hunk of Crunchy Salt and\n1 Cake-Lure Base.

label: ITEMINFO_1656
text: A recipe for crafting Potions from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Oran Berry and 1 Medicinal Leek.

label: ITEMINFO_1657
text: A recipe for crafting Super Potions from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Potion and 1 Pep-Up Plant.

label: ITEMINFO_1658
text: A recipe for crafting Hyper Potions from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Super Potion and 1 Vivichoke.

label: ITEMINFO_1659
text: A recipe for crafting Max Potions from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Sitrus Berry and 1 bunch of\nKing’s Leaf.

label: ITEMINFO_1660
text: A recipe for crafting Full Restores from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Max Potion and 1 Full Heal.

label: ITEMINFO_1888
text: A long loaf sliced into top and bottom halves. Its aroma\nof wheat and its straightforward, salty flavor make it pair\nwell with all kinds of sandwich ingredients.

label: ITEMINFO_1889
text: A condiment that packs a very tart punch yet pairs well\nwith various ingredients.

label: ITEMINFO_1890
text: A condiment with very salty and tart flavor. While a\nnumber of other ingredients go into its signature flavor,\nthe noble tomato is its heart and soul.

label: ITEMINFO_1891
text: A very spicy condiment that’s indispensable when bread\nis on the table. It pairs tremendously with ketchup.

label: ITEMINFO_1892
text: A condiment that unites salty and sweet and also packs a\nrichness that makes bread a delight to eat. The finest\nbutter products are made of 100 percent Moomoo Milk.

label: ITEMINFO_1893
text: A very sweet condiment. People in Paldea seem to favor\nthe sweet varieties over the unsweetened.

label: ITEMINFO_1894
text: A condiment with a very spicy kick. It’s thanks to\nScovillain that this sauce gets its signature mouth-\ntingling burn.

label: ITEMINFO_1895
text: A very salty seasoning, unsurprisingly. People quite\nlike the grains of salt that can be gathered from the\nfootprints of particularly jagged Naclstack.

label: ITEMINFO_1896
text: A seasoning packing very spicy flavor. It goes nicely\nwith oilier foods and works especially well when you\nadd just a pinch for a hint of flavor.

label: ITEMINFO_1897
text: A condiment that’s very sweet and very sour. It goes\nespecially well with fruit and is easy to incorporate into\na sandwich.

label: ITEMINFO_1898
text: A very sweet condiment. Folks in Paldea seem to love\nthe varieties that really let the sweetness sing.

label: ITEMINFO_1899
text: A condiment offering very sweet and very tart flavor.\nIt goes well with more ingredients than you’d expect,\nmaking it a convenient go-to.

label: ITEMINFO_1900
text: A condiment that’s very sweet and likewise very sour.\nTake care when adding it to sandwiches, as the sweet\nside can overwhelm.

label: ITEMINFO_1901
text: A condiment with sour and bitter notes. It’s surprisingly\nuseful, as it makes a nice counterpoint to oilier foods.

label: ITEMINFO_1902
text: A condiment offering faint notes of sour and bitter\nflavors. The most prized varieties are the ones Smoliv\nlove the smell of—such oils’ quality is assured.

label: ITEMINFO_1903
text: A very sour condiment. Vinegars derived from grapes are\npopular in Paldea. Highly effective when used to add\njust a light note of flavor.

label: ITEMINFO_1904
text: A legendary condiment told of only in books. Word has\nit that one taste of its sweet flavor stimulates the\ndigestive system and cures a lack of appetite.

label: ITEMINFO_1905
text: One of the condiments spoken of as legends. Its mellow\nsaltiness is said to be tremendously effective when it\ncomes to promoting health.

label: ITEMINFO_1906
text: This surpassingly sour condiment is said to be super\neffective in helping the eater recover from exhaustion.\nOnly a scant few people know it exists.

label: ITEMINFO_1907
text: A legendary condiment with a deeply bitter taste. It’s\nsaid to dramatically bolster a body’s immune defenses,\nthough that hasn’t been proven.

label: ITEMINFO_1908
text: The legendary condiment said to have the mightiest of\nall spicy flavors. It’s said that a single bite will kick the\nmetabolism into high gear immediately.

label: ITEMINFO_1909
text: This bitter-tasting ingredient is simple and\nstraightforward—just add it to all kinds of other\ningredients for a delightfully crunchy time.

label: ITEMINFO_1910
text: This very tart ingredient has a lot of savory elements\nto it, making it popular with many Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1911
text: A very tart ingredient. Some varieties are also very\nsweet, and these are prized above all others by the\npeople of Paldea.

label: ITEMINFO_1912
text: A tart and bitter ingredient. Using it together with rich-\ntasting ingredients in a sandwich will really make the\nmost of a cucumber’s fresh-veggie aroma.

label: ITEMINFO_1913
text: This very sour ingredient is made by pickling veggies\nin a flavorful brine made from spices and vinegar.

label: ITEMINFO_1914
text: This spicy veggie is indispensable to many sandwiches.\nIt goes well with rich ingredients.

label: ITEMINFO_1915
text: An ingredient with some sweetness to it. Its spiciness and\nfragrance are milder than those of other onions, making\nit a pleasant bite.

label: ITEMINFO_1916
text: An ingredient with some bitterness. When sliced, it adds\na nice accent to a sandwich.

label: ITEMINFO_1917
text: An ingredient with some bitterness—but its bitter notes\nand overall flavor are pleasantly mild compared to its\ngreen cousin.

label: ITEMINFO_1918
text: An ingredient with some bitterness. It’s not much\ndifferent from its red counterpart in flavor, but mixing\nthe colors makes a feast for the eyes.

label: ITEMINFO_1919
text: An ingredient with sweet notes—though its flavor is\nvery mild. The avocado’s richness, however, makes it\nsatisfying to eat.

label: ITEMINFO_1920
text: This very salty ingredient has been cooked just shy of\ncharred, making it burst with fragrance and tasty flavor.

label: ITEMINFO_1921
text: A very salty ingredient—and that very saltiness is what\nmakes it such a nice companion to veggies.

label: ITEMINFO_1922
text: This ingredient is very salty like regular ham, but the\ndifference is prosciutto is not cooked after it is cured,\ngiving it a fun freshness.

label: ITEMINFO_1923
text: A very salty and spicy ingredient. This type of sausage\nhas particularly robust salty flavor, and the spicier\nvarieties are extra popular.

label: ITEMINFO_1924
text: A very salty and bitter ingredient. The balance between\nthe potent saltiness and the herbs’ bitterness make this\nsausage a pleasure.

label: ITEMINFO_1925
text: This very salty ingredient is the thing to add if you want\nto make your sandwich truly filling.

label: ITEMINFO_1926
text: A very sweet and salty ingredient. It’s a nutritious\nprocessed food made with a concentrate derived from\nshed Klawf shells.

label: ITEMINFO_1927
text: A very salty and bitter ingredient with that unmistakable\nsmoky flavor. It pairs exceptionally well with veggies.

label: ITEMINFO_1928
text: When used in a sandwich, this very salty and bitter\ningredient is at its best paired with sour seasonings.

label: ITEMINFO_1929
text: An ingredient with a touch of saltiness. It’s full of\nnutrients and can be enjoyed with all sorts of seasonings.

label: ITEMINFO_1930
text: A very salty ingredient and a popular dish in Paldea.\nIt’s undeniably filling.

label: ITEMINFO_1931
text: An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It’s unclear how\nwell this raw block of tofu will serve as a sandwich filling.

label: ITEMINFO_1932
text: An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It’s unclear how\nwell this cooked rice will serve as a sandwich filling.

label: ITEMINFO_1933
text: A nice salty ingredient. It’s unclear how well these boiled\nnoodles will serve as a sandwich filling.

label: ITEMINFO_1934
text: This very tart ingredient—a soft salad that’s all about\npotatoes—pairs tremendously well with bread.

label: ITEMINFO_1935
text: A very salty ingredient. This thinly sliced cheese is\nperfect for adding to a sandwich.

label: ITEMINFO_1936
text: A very sweet ingredient. This go-to fruit is sweet and\nrich, and it’s beloved by many Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1937
text: A very tart and sweet ingredient, popular for its ability\nto make a sandwich visually striking.

label: ITEMINFO_1938
text: This very sweet ingredient is sliced thin to make it easy\nto add into a sandwich.

label: ITEMINFO_1939
text: A very tart ingredient that has a light touch of sweetness\nas well. It goes well with rich ingredients.

label: ITEMINFO_1940
text: This very tart ingredient is a fruit of southern lands,\nand its color and texture are a thrill. It’s been cut into\nchunks to be easily manageable.

label: ITEMINFO_1941
text: A very spicy ingredient—so spicy as to leave no room\nfor ambivalence about it. You either like it or you don’t.

label: ITEMINFO_1942
text: A very spicy condiment. Its distinctive sharp sizzle in\nyour sinuses makes it a good match for rich fillings.

label: ITEMINFO_1943
text: A very spicy condiment. Just watch out—use too much\nof this potent seasoning, and it’ll cancel out the other\nflavors.

label: ITEMINFO_1944
text: This very spicy condiment seems close to horseradish at\nfirst, but you’ll find that it has a superb flavor all its own.

label: ITEMINFO_1945
text: A very bitter ingredient that stands out among veggies\nfor its quirky flavor. People tend to either like it or not\nlike it—they rarely sit on the fence.

label: ITEMINFO_1946
text: A very bitter ingredient that’s quite versatile, as herbs\ngo. It’s fragrant and goes well with tomatoes.
